name: route_key_into_slot_state
description: Matches the incoming key against four stored slot keys and, on a match, stores the value into a per-key variable when it passes a threshold check; keys 14 to 17 set fixed values instead. Afterwards a common tail zeroes a 33-word buffer and updates the slot state and status code.

name: route_key_into_slot_state
description: Matches the incoming key against four stored slot keys and, on a match, stores the value into a per-key variable when it passes a threshold check; keys 14 to 17 set fixed values instead. Afterwards a common tail zeroes a 33-word buffer and updates the slot state and status code.

name: store_if_above_key_limit
description: Returns early when the incoming value is below a limit chosen from the key number. Otherwise it stores the value into the variable for keys 35, 36 or 5 to 13, sets a fixed value for keys 14 to 17 when a slot matches, then runs the common slot state update.

name: store_if_above_key6_limit
description: Returns early when the incoming value is below a limit taken from a key-6 threshold table indexed by the second argument. Otherwise it stores the value into the matching per-key variable and then runs the common slot state update.

name: store_if_above_key7_limit
description: Returns early when the incoming value is below a limit taken from a key-7 threshold table indexed by the second argument. Otherwise it stores the value into the matching per-key variable and then runs the common slot state update.

name: store_if_above_key8_limit

name: store_if_above_key9_limit

name: store_if_above_key10_limit
description: Returns early when the incoming value is below a limit taken from a key-10 threshold table indexed by the second argument. Otherwise it stores the value into the matching per-key variable and then runs the common slot state update.

name: store_if_above_key11_limit
description: Returns early when the incoming value is below a limit taken from a key-11 threshold table indexed by the second argument. Otherwise it stores the value into the matching per-key variable and then runs the common slot state update.

name: store_if_above_base_limit
description: Returns early when the incoming value is below one fixed base limit. Otherwise it stores the value into the variable for keys 35, 36 or 5 to 13, sets fixed values for keys 14 to 17 when a slot matches, then runs the common slot state update.

name: store_if_above_base_limit
description: Returns early when the incoming value is below one fixed base limit. Otherwise it stores the value into the variable for keys 35, 36 or 5 to 13, sets fixed values for keys 14 to 17 when a slot matches, then runs the common slot state update.

name: store_if_above_secondary_limit
description: Returns early when the incoming value is below a second fixed limit. Otherwise it stores the value into the variable for keys 35, 36 or 5 to 13, sets fixed values for keys 14 to 17 when a slot matches, then runs the common slot state update.

name: store_if_above_tertiary_limit
description: Returns early when the incoming value is below a third fixed limit. Otherwise it stores the value into the variable for keys 35, 36 or 5 to 13, sets fixed values for keys 14 to 17 when a slot matches, then runs the common slot state update.

name: set_key11_limit_and_update
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value as the key-11 limit and then runs the common slot state update, which zeroes a 33-word buffer and sets the slot state and status code.

name: set_key10_limit_and_update
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value as the key-10 limit and then runs the common slot state update, which zeroes a 33-word buffer and sets the slot state and status code.

name: set_key9_limit_and_update
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value as the key-9 limit and then runs the common slot state update, which zeroes a 33-word buffer and sets the slot state and status code.

name: set_key8_limit_and_update
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value as the key-8 limit and then runs the common slot state update, which zeroes a 33-word buffer and sets the slot state and status code.

name: set_key7_limit_and_update
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value as the key-7 limit and then runs the common slot state update, which zeroes a 33-word buffer and sets the slot state and status code.

name: set_key6_limit_and_update
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value as the key-6 limit and then runs the common slot state update, which zeroes a 33-word buffer and sets the slot state and status code.

name: set_key5_limit_and_update
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value as the key-5 limit and then runs the common slot state update, which zeroes a 33-word buffer and sets the slot state and status code.

name: set_secondary_limit_and_update
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value as the secondary limit and then runs the common slot state update, which zeroes a 33-word buffer and sets the slot state and status code.

name: set_tertiary_limit_and_update
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit value as the tertiary limit and then runs the common slot state update, which zeroes a 33-word buffer and sets the slot state and status code.

name: set_fixed_values_for_keys
description: For keys 14 to 17 it sets a fixed value (32000, 1, 2 or 2) and returns early when a stored slot matches the key; otherwise it continues to the common slot state update. Keys below 18 that are not 14 to 17 return unchanged.

name: set_fixed_value_key14_17
description: If the second argument is 14, 15, 16 or 17 it sets the matching fixed value (32000, 1, 2 or 2) and returns early; any other argument continues to the common slot state update.

name: set_fixed_value_key15_17
description: If the second argument is 15, 16 or 17 it sets the matching fixed value (1, 2 or 2) and returns early; any other argument continues to the common slot state update.

name: set_fixed_value_key16_17
description: If the second argument is 16 or 17 it sets the matching fixed value (2 or 2) and returns early; any other argument continues to the common slot state update.

name: set_fixed_value_key17
description: If the second argument is 17 it sets the fixed value 2 for that key and returns early; any other argument continues to the common slot state update.

name: set_fixed_value_then_update
description: For the second argument 14 to 17 it sets the matching fixed value (32000, 1, 2 or 2) and then runs the common slot state update; any other argument returns without changes.

name: set_key15_17_fixed_update
description: For keys 15 to 17 it sets the matching fixed value (1, 2 or 2) and then runs the common slot state update; other arguments return without changes.

name: set_key16_17_fixed_update
description: For keys 16 and 17 it sets their fixed value of 2 and then runs the common slot state update; other arguments return without changes.

name: set_key17_fixed_update
description: For key 17 it sets the fixed value 2 and then runs the common slot state update; other arguments return without changes.

name: clear_slot_state_ch3
description: Checks the stored slot values for zero in a fixed order and, for the first slot that qualifies, zeroes a 33-word buffer and records the key there with state 4, 3, 2 or 1. Its facts show the channel-3 audio location register is touched.

name: clear_slot_state_ch2
description: Checks the stored slot values for zero in a fixed order and, for the first slot that qualifies, zeroes a 33-word buffer and records the key there with state 4, 3, 2 or 1. Its facts show the channel-2 audio location register is touched.

name: clear_slot_state_ch1
description: Checks the stored slot values for zero in a fixed order and, for the first slot that qualifies, zeroes a 33-word buffer and records the key there with state 4, 3, 2 or 1. Its facts show the channel-1 audio location register is touched.

name: clear_slot_state_ch0
description: Checks the stored slot values for zero in a fixed order and, for the first slot that qualifies, zeroes a 33-word buffer and records the key there with state 4, 3, 2 or 1. Its facts show the channel-0 audio location register is touched.

name: select_empty_slot_and_clear
description: When its flag is zero it checks the four stored slot values in order, zeroes a 33-word buffer and records the key in the first qualifying slot, setting state 4, 3, 2 or 1. When the flag is set it sets the state to 255 instead.

name: clear_slot_state_by_order
description: Checks four slot conditions in order and, for the first one that matches, zeroes a 33-word buffer and records the key in that slot with state 4, 3, 2 or 1.

name: clear_slot_state_three_way
description: Checks three slot conditions in order and, for the first one that matches, zeroes a 33-word buffer and records the key in that slot with state 3, 2 or 1.

name: clear_slot_state_by_flag
description: If the flag is zero it zeroes a 33-word buffer and records the key as the state-2 slot value; otherwise it does the same for state 1. It then clears the key and returns.

name: clear_slot_state_one
description: Zeroes a 33-word buffer, records the key as the state-1 slot value, sets the state to 1 and clears the key before returning.

name: route_audio_channels
description: Compares a global value with four stored slot values and calls a routine for each match, then resets the global to zero. Its facts show the four audio channel location registers are touched.

name: reset_audio_state
description: Sets a flag, then four times calls a routine and clears a 33-word buffer, and finally clears the flag. Its facts show the four audio channel location registers are touched.

name: set_flag_and_store_value
description: Sets one flag variable to 1, stores the incoming register value into a second variable and sets a third variable to 64.

name: set_state_two_and_store
description: Sets one variable to 2, stores the incoming register value into a second variable and clears a third variable to zero.

name: allocate_record_into_slot
description: Rejects an argument of zero or above 64. If the key matches a stored slot it calls two helpers and returns; otherwise it picks a state from 1 to 4 using stored thresholds, fills a record with the argument, the value 200 and the second argument, calls a helper, then clears the record on result 255 or clears the stored slot for that state and sets its flag.

name: allocate_record_by_threshold
description: Picks a state from 1 to 4 using stored thresholds and returns early when the argument is below the chosen threshold. Otherwise it fills a record with the argument, the value 200 and the second argument, calls a helper, then clears the record on result 255 or clears the stored slot for that state and sets its flag.

name: allocate_record_by_threshold
description: Picks a state from 1 to 4 using stored thresholds and returns early when the argument is below the chosen threshold. Otherwise it fills a record with the argument, the value 200 and the second argument, calls a helper, then clears the record on result 255 or clears the stored slot for that state and sets its flag.

name: allocate_record_threshold_alt
description: A shorter variant of the threshold-based record allocation: it returns early below the chosen threshold, otherwise fills a record with the argument and the value 200, calls a helper, and clears the record or marks the slot as used based on the result.

name: allocate_record_by_threshold_b
description: Picks a state from 1 to 4 using three stored thresholds and returns early when the argument is below the chosen threshold. Otherwise it fills a record with the argument, the value 200 and the second argument, calls a helper, then clears the record on result 255 or clears the stored slot for that state and sets its flag.

name: allocate_record_by_threshold_c
description: Picks a state from 1 to 3 (defaulting to 4) using stored thresholds and returns early when the argument is below the chosen threshold. Otherwise it fills a record with the argument, the value 200 and the second argument, calls a helper, then clears the record on result 255 or clears the stored slot for that state and sets its flag.

name: allocate_record_if_at_least
description: Chooses a state from 1 to 4 using stored thresholds and, only when the argument is at least the chosen threshold, fills a record with the argument, the value 200 and the second argument, calls a helper, then clears the record on result 255 or clears the stored slot for that state and sets its flag.

name: allocate_record_for_given_state
description: Fills a record at the address in A2 with the second argument, the value 200 and the argument D1, calls a helper with the state value from D6, then clears the record on result 255 or clears the stored slot for that state and sets its flag.

name: mark_slot_cleared_by_result
description: Stores the helper result into the record at offset 14, then clears the stored slot for state 4, 3 or 2 and sets its related flag; any other result clears the state-1 slot and sets its flag.

name: clear_slot_for_result_state
description: Clears the stored slot for state 3 or 2 and sets the related flag depending on the register argument; any other argument clears the state-1 slot and sets its flag.

name: clear_slot_for_result_two
description: Clears the stored state-2 slot and sets its flag when the argument is 2; otherwise it clears the state-1 slot and sets its flag.

name: clear_state_one_flag
description: Clears the stored state-1 slot value, sets the related flag to 1 and then clears the completion flag before returning.

name: call_two_helpers_then_finish
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and then clears the completion flag before returning.

name: store_status_into_record
description: Sets the first word of a record to 1, uses the record's stored state to clear the matching flag (states 4, 3 or 2, otherwise a fallback flag), then writes the register arguments and a long value into the record fields and zeroes the last field.

name: store_record_clear_flag_three
description: Clears the flag for state 3 or 2 chosen by the stored state value, using a fallback flag for other values, then writes the register arguments and a long value into the record, sets its first word to 1 and zeroes its last field.

name: store_record_clear_flag_two
description: Clears the state-2 flag when the stored state is 2, otherwise a fallback flag, then writes the register arguments and a long value into the record fields.

name: store_record_clear_fallback
description: Clears a fallback flag, then writes the register arguments and a long value into the record fields, setting the first word to 1 and zeroing the last field.

name: store_regs_to_block
description: Sets the first word of the record to 1, writes the register arguments and a long value into its fields, and zeroes the last word.

name: set_audio_channel_data
description: Picks an Amiga audio channel from 0 to 3 using the record's stored state. When that slot's flag is clear it writes the record's volume and period fields to that channel's hardware registers; otherwise it clears the record's first and fifth words.

name: set_audio_channel_data
description: Picks an Amiga audio channel from 0 to 3 using the record's stored state. When that slot's flag is clear it writes the record's volume and period fields to that channel's hardware registers; otherwise it clears the record's first and fifth words.

name: init_channel_table_entries
description: Clears a 136-word buffer, copies four longword values from a table entry selected by an index into globals when the index is non-zero, zeroes eight pointers and assigns the fixed identifiers 1 to 8, then calls a helper when the index is 10.

name: init_channel_table_entries
description: Clears a 136-word buffer, copies four longword values from a table entry selected by an index into globals when the index is non-zero, zeroes eight pointers and assigns the fixed identifiers 1 to 8, then calls a helper when the index is 10.

description: Clears a 136-word buffer, copies four longword values from a table entry selected by an index into globals when the index is non-zero, zeroes eight pointers and assigns the fixed identifiers 1 to 8, then calls a helper when the index is 10.

description: Clears a 136-word buffer, copies four longword values from a table entry selected by an index into globals when the index is non-zero, zeroes eight pointers and assigns the fixed identifiers 1 to 8, then calls a helper when the index is 10.

name: tick_channel_levels_and_slots
description: Returns at once when its busy flag is set. Otherwise it steps a counter toward a target and adjusts a level, then for four channels counts ticks and lowers the channel level past 50 ticks; a channel whose level drops below 2 is cleared. It then checks the four stored slot states and calls helpers for each.

name: clear_slot_flag_by_state
description: Clears the flag belonging to the state in D0 (4, 3, 2 or 1) and then calls a helper; other values return without change. The facts list the channel-0 audio location register as touched.

name: set_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets one global flag to 1 and then calls a helper routine before returning.

name: reset_channel_state_flags
description: Calls a helper, clears the paired state variables for each channel whose flag equals 1, loads a longword from a table indexed by a counter shifted by two, and then clears two counters.

name: clear_flag_and_call_helper
description: Clears one global flag to zero and then calls a helper routine before returning. The facts list the channel-0 audio location register as touched.

name: set_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets one global flag to 1 and then calls a helper routine before returning.

name: set_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets one global flag to 1 and then calls a helper routine before returning.

name: load_table_value_and_clear
description: Calls a helper, loads a longword from a table indexed by a counter shifted by two into a variable, then clears that counter and a second variable.

name: clear_flag_and_call_helper
description: Clears one global flag to zero and then calls a helper routine before returning. The facts list the channel-1 audio location register as touched.

name: set_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets one global flag to 1 and then calls a helper routine before returning. The facts list the channel-1 audio location register as touched.

name: set_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets one global flag to 1 and then calls a helper routine before returning.

name: load_table_value_and_clear
description: Calls a helper, loads a longword from a table indexed by a counter shifted by two into a variable, then clears that counter and a second variable.

name: clear_flag_and_call_helper
description: Clears one global flag to zero and then calls a helper routine before returning. The facts list the channel-2 audio location register as touched.

name: set_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets one global flag to 1 and then calls a helper routine before returning. The facts list the channel-2 audio location register as touched.

name: set_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets one global flag to 1 and then calls a helper routine before returning.

name: load_table_value_and_clear
description: Calls a helper, loads a longword from a table indexed by a counter shifted by two into a variable, then clears that counter and a second variable.

name: clear_flag_and_call_helper
description: Clears one global flag to zero and then calls a helper routine before returning. The facts list the channel-3 audio location register as touched.

name: set_flag_and_call_helper
description: Sets one global flag to 1 and then calls a helper routine before returning. The facts list the channel-3 audio location register as touched.

name: advance_audio_channel_sequence
description: Advances one audio channel's playback: when its duration counter runs out it fetches the next value pair from a list that ends on a zero entry, updates the channel's pitch and envelope fields, and writes the resulting value into the output at offset 2. The facts show the DMA control register is touched.

name: start_audio_channel_sequence
description: Reads the first word of an input sequence and stops on zero. Otherwise it copies the channel's fields, resets its counters and writes the next output value, reduced by the channel's adjustment when one is set. The facts show the DMA control register is touched.

name: init_audio_channel_output
description: Stores the first input word as the channel counter and points the channel at a shared data area, then writes its next output value at offset 8, reduced by the channel's adjustment when one is set. The facts show the DMA control register is touched.

name: select_audio_sequence_entry
description: Picks the next entry from either a counted list or a fixed pointer and returns when its value is zero. Otherwise it loads the channel's fields and writes its next output value.

name: load_next_audio_sequence_entry
description: Decrements the channel's counter, loads the next value and duration pair from its list and returns on a zero entry. Otherwise it updates the channel fields and writes the next output value.

name: clear_ciaa_bit_start_seq
description: Clears bit 1 of the CIA-A port value, which the facts say holds the fire buttons and disk status, then loads the first entry of an input sequence and writes the next output value.

name: set_ciaa_bit_start_seq
description: Sets bit 1 of the CIA-A port value, which the facts say holds the fire buttons and disk status, then loads the first entry of an input sequence and writes the next output value.

name: load_seq_header_and_start
description: Reads a header from an input structure to set the channel's fields, in a short or long form depending on its first word, then loads the first sequence entry and writes its output value.

name: start_audio_sequence_from_list
description: Fetches the next sequence pointer from the channel's list and advances it. It stops on a zero entry; otherwise it copies the entry's fields, resets counters and writes the next output value, reduced by the channel's adjustment when one is set.

name: load_audio_entry_pointer
description: Stores a longword from the input into the channel's pointer field, points its list at the following data, then loads the entry and writes the next output value.

name: copy_longs_and_start_entry
description: Copies two longwords from the input into the channel's fields at offsets 8 and 12, then loads the first entry of its list and writes the next output value.

name: set_active_copy_fields_start
description: Marks the channel active, copies three longwords from the input into its fields at offsets 50, 54 and 58, then loads the first entry and writes the next output value.

name: clear_level_and_start_entry
description: Clears the channel's field at offset 8, then loads the first entry of its list and writes the next output value.

name: clear_active_and_start_entry
description: Clears the channel's active field at offset 16, then loads the first entry of its list and writes the next output value.

name: clear_slot_for_channel_index
description: Maps the input value 5, 6, 7 or 8 to the control bit 4, 8, 2 or 1 respectively, writes that bit then the values 1 and 0 to the control word, and clears the matching stored slot. Other values return without change.

name: enable_audio_channel_zero
description: Writes the control values 1, 1 and 0 to the global control word and clears the stored slot for channel 0. Its facts show the channel-0 period and volume registers and the DMA control register are touched.

name: enable_audio_channel_one
description: Writes the control values 2, 1 and 0 to the global control word and clears the stored slot for channel 1. Its facts show the channel-1 period and volume registers and the DMA control register are touched.

name: enable_audio_channel_two
description: Writes the control values 4, 1 and 0 to the global control word and clears the stored slot for channel 2. Its facts show the channel-2 period and volume registers and the DMA control register are touched.

name: enable_audio_channel_three
description: Writes the control values 8, 1 and 0 to the global control word and clears the stored slot for channel 3. Its facts show the channel-3 period and volume registers and the DMA control register are touched.

name: disable_audio_channel_zero
description: Writes the control values 1, 1 and 0 to the global control word. Its facts show the channel-0 period and volume registers and the DMA control register are touched.

name: disable_audio_channel_one
description: Writes the control values 2, 1 and 0 to the global control word. Its facts show the channel-1 period and volume registers and the DMA control register are touched.

name: disable_audio_channel_two
description: Writes the control values 4, 1 and 0 to the global control word. Its facts show the channel-2 period and volume registers and the DMA control register are touched.

name: disable_audio_channel_three
description: Writes the control values 8, 1 and 0 to the global control word. Its facts show the channel-3 period and volume registers and the DMA control register are touched.

name: start_flagged_audio_sequence
description: Sets the channel's field at offset 66 to 1, then reads the first entry of its input sequence, copies its fields and writes the next output value. A zero entry stops it.

name: start_audio_entry_from_pointer
description: Takes the next pointer from the channel's pointer list and advances the list by one longword, then loads that entry's fields and writes the next output value. A zero entry stops it.

name: clear_flag_and_call
description: Clears a byte at a fixed offset from the base register, calls a helper, then sets a global byte to 1 and returns the helper's result.

name: call_helper_then_set_flag
description: Calls a helper routine and then sets a global flag byte to 1 before returning.

name: scan_for_next_nonzero_entry
description: When the input is negative or a pending flag is set, it clears a status bit and a flag. It then scans a byte array of up to eight entries for the next nonzero one, using a helper to advance, records the found index plus one and calls a helper with it.

name: set_flag_if_status_zero
description: Writes a byte flag that is 255 when a status byte at a fixed offset is zero, and 0 otherwise.

name: set_flag_from_zero_flag
description: Writes a byte flag that is 255 when the processor zero flag from the previous comparison is set, and 0 otherwise.

name: reset_index_and_select_nine
description: Sets a stored index word to minus one, clears a flag byte and a flag global, sets the selector global to 9 and calls a helper routine.

name: forward_input_if_enabled
description: When a status byte at a fixed offset is set, it forwards the input value to a helper after clearing a flag. The input value 20 is ignored unless a second status byte is also set.

name: store_value_and_call_helper
description: Stores the register argument into a global variable and calls a helper routine.

name: clamp_and_forward_value
description: When a status byte at a fixed offset is set, it clamps the second argument to at most 63 and, if that leaves it non-zero, clears a flag, stores the first argument and calls a helper.

name: call_helper_if_index_negative
description: Calls a helper only when a status byte is set and a stored index word is negative; otherwise it returns without effect.

name: conditional_handler_dispatch
description: Checks a byte flag in a structure, a byte range below 15 and a non-zero word in the structure. If all are true it clears a global flag, stores the incoming value into a global variable and calls a helper; otherwise it returns without effect.

name: set_control_byte_active
description: Sets a control byte at a fixed offset from the base register to 255.

name: reset_or_scan_next_entry
description: When a status byte at a fixed offset is zero it resets the stored index to minus one, clears a flag and calls a helper with selector 9. Otherwise it clears a status bit and scans a byte array of up to eight entries for the next nonzero one, records its index plus one and calls a helper.

name: return_input_byte
description: Returns its byte argument unchanged, a pass-through with no visible side effects in the decompiled code.

name: return_input_byte
description: Returns its byte argument unchanged, a pass-through with no visible side effects in the decompiled code. The facts list one call that the decompiled code does not show.

name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns; the decompiled body is a single return with no effect.

name: return_input_byte
description: Returns its byte argument unchanged, a pass-through with no visible side effects in the decompiled code.

name: return_input_byte
description: Returns its byte argument unchanged, a pass-through with no visible side effects in the decompiled code.

name: return_input_byte
description: Returns its byte argument unchanged, a pass-through with no visible side effects in the decompiled code.

name: call_routines_from_table
description: Calls a fixed sequence of six routines: five through function pointers at offsets 312, 222, 144, 126 and 348 from the base register, and one direct call placed after the second pointer call.

name: iterate_and_call_table_entries
description: Calls two fixed routines, then loops over a table whose count is stored at a fixed offset. For each entry it calls two function pointers with computed parameters and advances the entry pointer by 28 bytes.

name: run_counted_helper_loops
description: Returns unless its byte argument is 3. Otherwise it copies a longword within its data block, then runs several counted loops, each calling a helper as many times as a routine result indicates; one branch caps its count at 25.

name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns; the decompiled body is a single return with no effect.

name: run_counted_helper_loops
description: Returns unless its byte argument is 3. Otherwise it copies a longword within its data block, then runs several counted loops, each calling a helper as many times as a routine result indicates; one branch caps its count at 25.

name: compute_wide_value_and_store
description: Calls helpers in sequence. When a flag is clear it sets two byte fields (60 and 32), computes a 64-bit value from a counter scaled by four plus two stored 32-bit parts with carry propagation, stores it as two longwords at offsets 126 and 130, then calls one helper when the value is zero and another when it is not.

name: forward_to_table_routine_a
description: Calls one routine through a function pointer stored at a fixed offset from the base register, then returns.

name: copy_record_fields_and_update
description: Calls a routine, then when a flag is clear either copies one byte and sets a status byte to 255, or copies a block of eight values from the source record. If a second call sets its flag, it adds a 64-bit value into the destination's accumulator fields and stores a derived wide value at offsets 126 and 130 before calling a follow-up routine.

name: update_wide_record_values
description: Copies a byte from a source record and sets a status byte to 255. If a flag from a call is set it adds a 64-bit increment into the destination's accumulator fields, sets two status bytes, stores a derived wide value at offsets 126 and 130 and calls follow-up routines.

name: forward_to_table_routine_b
description: Calls one routine through a function pointer stored at a second fixed offset from the base register, then returns.

name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns; the decompiled body is a single return with no effect.

name: run_count_gated_routine_chain
description: Calls a helper that returns a count. If the count minus one is non-zero it returns that value; otherwise it runs a chain of routines that sets a status byte from a stored field and adds 100000 and then 200000 to a longword at offset 44.

name: set_status_bytes_and_call
description: Calls a helper and, when a flag from it is clear, stores a byte argument at offset 210, calls a helper, sets the byte at offset 211 to 20 and calls another helper.

name: set_status_and_add_increments
description: Calls a helper and, when a flag from it is clear, stores a byte argument at offset 210, sets the byte at offset 211 to 20 and adds 100000 to a longword at offset 44. When a further flag is clear it also adds 200000.

name: fetch_table_word_into_record
description: Calls a function pointer to get a value and uses its masked bits plus a second index to read a word from a global table. It stores that word at offset 238 of the record and sets the byte at offset 236 to 251.

name: set_record_status_from_source
description: When a condition from a call is clear it sets the byte at offset 213 to 255, then sets the byte at offset 211 to 44 and copies a byte from the source record at offset 124 into offset 68.

name: fill_record_run_from_table
description: Calls helpers to pick a value from a global table indexed by a record field and a type byte, then fills a run of bytes in the record with it while a remaining count stays positive. It updates the record's word at offset 234 and flag word at offset 158, and returns minus one.

name: fill_record_run_from_table
description: Calls helpers to pick a value from a global table indexed by a record field and a type byte, then fills a run of bytes in the record with it while a remaining count stays positive. It updates the record's word at offset 234 and flag word at offset 158, and returns minus one.

name: fill_run_from_table_tail
description: Enters the run-filling sequence partway: it looks up a table value from the source byte, fills a run of record bytes with it and stores the remaining count and flags. It returns minus one.

name: fill_run_bytes_and_store
description: Fills consecutive bytes in the record with a table value while a count is positive, then applies a table-based adjustment. It stores the remaining count word at offset 234 and a flags longword at offset 158, and returns minus one.

name: lookup_table_entry
description: Forms a value from a call result, the byte at offset 236 and a second argument, scans a global word table until an entry reaches it, and returns the matching byte from a companion table.

name: call_four_subroutines
description: Calls one routine four times in sequence and then returns to the caller.

name: check_count_and_store_result
description: Calls a function pointer and stores its high word at offset 198, then calls a routine that returns a count. When the count exceeds 3 it calls another routine and, if that result is non-negative, stores it at offsets 202 and 206 and returns minus one.

name: check_flag_and_call
description: Returns minus one after calling two function pointers when a word flag at a fixed offset is non-zero; otherwise it returns zero.

name: scan_bit_flag_loop
description: When a word flag is set, it calls a routine and then scans records of a fixed size for a set bit in a status byte, decrementing a counter until a bit is found or the counter runs out. It returns minus one when a bit is found, otherwise zero.

name: store_result_and_call
description: Calls a function pointer, stores its result at offset 118 of the record, then calls a second function pointer and returns the register result.

name: clear_structure_fields
description: Calls two function pointers and then clears a longword at offset 138 and a word at offset 142 of the record.

name: clear_longword_and_return_byte
description: Clears a longword at a fixed offset from the base register and returns its byte argument unchanged.

name: clear_longword_at_offset
description: Clears a longword at a fixed offset from the base register and returns.
